answer: A bond of 43% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. Deposits are visible in ridge, and forge reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 48 aliases, and each one needs its own funded echo account. A farm of 2903 identities would post 4731 proofs and burn roughly 43 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
